questions.stem: An infant girl is born prematurely at 29 weeks of gestation due to an incompetent cervix and undergoes spontaneous vaginal delivery. Given the risks associated with prematurity, the neonate is closely monitored and admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU). Which aspect of her clinical course in the NICU is most likely to correlate with her long-term clinical outcome five years in the future?
